viewsWelcome.coregraph.explorer:
CoreGraph shows call-graph metrics for the active file.

Open any Rust, TypeScript/TSX, JavaScript/JSX, Python, Go, Java, or Kotlin file to see its symbols and dependency edges.

[Show Daemon Status](command:coregraph.daemonStatus)
[Restart Daemon](command:coregraph.daemonRestart)
walkthrough.title: Get Started with CoreGraph
walkthrough.description: Learn how CoreGraph surfaces call-graph metrics, understands your code structure, and keeps the daemon healthy.
walkthrough.step1.title: What is CoreGraph?
walkthrough.step1.description: CoreGraph indexes your codebase into a call graph and surfaces reach, impact, and confidence scores directly in the editor.
walkthrough.step2.title: Understanding Scores
walkthrough.step2.description: Learn what reach, impact, confidence, stale, and Orphan mean — and when to act on high-impact symbols.
walkthrough.step3.title: Daemon Management
walkthrough.step3.description: Control the CoreGraph daemon with Show Status, Restart, and Stop commands from the Command Palette.
